items.title: 52043_Herman Autrey oral history interview
items.q: Well, he was with Duke, and this and that and the other happened

ctx.x: The bass players changed a bit, didn't they?

Oh, they did. After -- first, what I told you was Billy Taylor (Unintelligible) he was a great man. Well, he was with Duke, and this and that and the other happened, and from there we -- I'm trying to think what other bass. I know -- I know two or three. I'm trying -- I'm trying to put them in con- cession. Charlie Turner, then before that we had Cedric Wallace, bass player.
